page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Main text in one column with a marginal note on the left (Aphor. I.) beside the first lines, and a second left marginal note (I. deratio ne uictus.) beside the Caput IIII paragraph. A centred italic line below the text, then the heading CAPVT IIII, then the text with a large initial S. No text on the right side beyond the main column.

main_text.p: Vt si puero multoties edere assueto propter morbu toties ministrare cibu non possimus, quod a numero deest, id quantitate ipsa sup-Aphor. I.plebimus. Vt scite a Galeno scriptum est in expositione illius, Quibus semel, aut bis &c. vbi ita scribit: Si vero accessiones no permiserint, neq; alimenti offerendi occasiones fuerint multae, raro plura dabimus. Vnde quida male hunc vertit locum, in hunc modu, Neque multi alimeti offerendi occasiones fuerint. Hyems multu exhibendu esse indicat: consimiliter et regio frigida. Sed haec ad imminuendam victus quantitate, qua consuetudo indicat, vires habent: minime ad augendam. Ab ijs ergo victus quantitas diminienda est.
A quibus numerus oblationis cibi sumatur.
main_text.head: CAPVT IIII.
main_text.p: SED easdem numerus habet considerationes. nam a consuetudine in primis, & a morbi dispositione oblationis numerum sciI. deratio ne uictus.to sumendum esse: vt scriptum est ab Hippocrate in haec verba: Qui enim bis cibari sunt soliti,

page.notes: Marginal notes: "Aphor. I." beside the first lines; "I. deratio / ne uictus." beside the Caput IIII paragraph. Small italic line above CAPVT IIII is a summary of the chapter, not a heading. Initial S is a large decorated letter, joined to SED. Some words near the right edge of the text are faint.
